🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive; confirmation: broad sector participation but mixed internals among large caps (AAPL ABOVE TREND vs NVDA CORRECTION) and leadership concentration moderate (3/5 Technology in Top 5), supporting a neutral stance.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Energy leads: XOM (1W: +2.33% | 1M: +4.58%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +3.28% | 1M: +3.46%) ABOVE TREND. Utilities/Real Estate strong: D (1W: +8.45% | 1M: +12.04%) ABOVE TREND, AMT (1W: +7.79% | 1M: +4.24%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Materials weak: DOW (1W: -7.40% | 1M: -7.47%) BELOW TREND, NEM (1W: -6.88% | 1M: -3.15%) BELOW TREND. Industrials lag: DE (1W: -7.53% | 1M: -8.39%) BELOW TREND, CAT (1W: -5.90% | 1M: +7.06%) CORRECTION.

📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: IBM (1W: +15.84% | 1M: +1.18%) ABOVE TREND, NOW (1W: +10.15% | 1M: -3.28%) RECOVERY, ACN (1W: +8.46% | 1M: -6.43%) RECOVERY, D (1W: +8.45% | 1M: +12.04%) ABOVE TREND, AMT (1W: +7.79% | 1M: +4.24%) ABOVE TREND — Leadership: moderate concentration (3/5 Technology); style mixed / no clear leadership.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: INTU (1W: -18.83% | 1M: -24.86%) BELOW TREND, WMT (1W: -8.39% | 1M: -6.47%) BELOW TREND, DE (1W: -7.53% | 1M: -8.39%) BELOW TREND, DOW (1W: -7.40% | 1M: -7.47%) BELOW TREND, NEE (1W: -6.26% | 1M: -0.34%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in Industrials/Materials/Staples.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest 1W movers: IBM (1W: +15.84% | 1M: +1.18%) ABOVE TREND, NOW (1W: +10.15% | 1M: -3.28%) RECOVERY, QCOM (1W: +6.66% | 1M: +56.84%) ABOVE TREND, PANW (1W: +6.18% | 1M: +39.58%) ABOVE TREND, SHOP (1W: +7.64% | 1M: -20.54%) RECOVERY — note MAJOR divergence across large caps (≥3) with 1W vs 1M mismatches; tactical caution advised.

🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed internals with pockets of strength and exhaustion: AAPL (1W: +2.27% | 1M: +11.75%) ABOVE TREND, QCOM (1W: +6.66% | 1M: +56.84%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: -6.88% | 1M: +8.40%) CORRECTION, GOOGL (1W: -3.34% | 1M: +14.25%) CORRECTION, INTU (1W: -18.83% | 1M: -24.86%) BELOW TREND — sector part of the 8/11 positive but internals uneven.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials show selective strength: MET (1W: +6.47% | 1M: +10.36%) ABOVE TREND, V (1W: +2.67% | 1M: +6.59%) ABOVE TREND, JPM (1W: +1.03% | 1M: -3.20%) RECOVERY — sector positive in 8/11 but mixed 1M trends warrant stock selection.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Defensive element present with leaders and rotations: LLY (1W: +3.65% | 1M: +13.24%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: +0.40% | 1M: +2.49%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: -4.16% | 1M: +8.19%) CORRECTION — sector included in the positive 8/11 but watch selective pullbacks.

🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor exposure to selective Energy and Financial names showing ABOVE TREND (XOM, CVX, MET, V) and maintain positions in resilient Utilities/REITs (D, AMT); reduce exposure to structurally weak Industrials/Materials and high-multiple Tech names in CORRECTION (NVDA, INTU). Style: mixed / no clear leadership given divergent large-cap internals.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: IBM (1W: +15.84% | 1M: +1.18%) ABOVE TREND, QCOM (1W: +6.66% | 1M: +56.84%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +3.65% | 1M: +13.24%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: INTU (1W: -18.83% | 1M: -24.86%) BELOW TREND, WMT (1W: -8.39% | 1M: -6.47%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: -6.88% | 1M: +8.40%) CORRECTION.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Utilities and Energy (both part of 8/11 sectors positive; D and XOM showing strength). BEARISH: Materials and Industrials (both 1W negative; monitor DOW, DE, CAT for further downside).

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Watch NVDA (1W: -6.88% | 1M: +8.40%) hold of the 1W lows to stabilize CORRECTION; AAPL (1W: +2.27% | 1M: +11.75%) maintaining ABOVE TREND to confirm leadership; INTU (1W: -18.83% | 1M: -24.86%) reclaiming short-term losses would be needed to change BELOW TREND status; monitor JPM (1W: +1.03% | 1M: -3.20%) turning 1M positive to validate Financials momentum.

📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
D (+85): NextEra/Dominion acquisition headline; D (1W: +8.45% | 1M: +12.04%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed. TJX (+80): raises guidance; TJX (1W: +6.86% | 1M: -0.31%) RECOVERY — watch follow-through. NVDA (+55): CFO comments on CPU revenue; NVDA (1W: -6.88% | 1M: +8.40%) CORRECTION — sentiment positive but price diverging (distribution risk).

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
AMGN (-80): safety warnings headline; AMGn (trend not provided in detail) — material negative news to monitor. META (-45): fraud-ads allegations; META (1W: -1.79% | 1M: -9.98%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirmed. MSFT (-45): GitHub security scare; MSFT (1W: +2.58% | 1M: -2.98%) RECOVERY — negative headlines diverging from short-term price strength.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, style mixed / no clear leadership. LLY (1W: +3.65% | 1M: +13.24%) ABOVE TREND and XOM (1W: +2.33% | 1M: +4.58%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength while NVDA (1W: -6.88% | 1M: +8.40%) CORRECTION and INTU (1W: -18.83% | 1M: -24.86%) BELOW TREND are key weaknesses. Key risk: major 1W vs 1M divergences among large caps and mixed news flow (NVDA, MSFT headlines) could delay a clear regime shift, so monitor sentiment-confirmation for entries.
